# Introduction to the Dataset



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidyverse)
library(skimr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

nyc_dog_license <- read_csv(
  'https://bcdanl.github.io/data/nyc_dog_license.csv')
nyc_zips_coord <- read_csv(
  'https://bcdanl.github.io/data/nyc_zips_coord.csv')
nyc_zips_df <- read_csv(
  'https://bcdanl.github.io/data/nyc_zips_df.csv')
```

# Top 5 Dog Breeds in NYC



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
top_5 <- nyc_dog_license |> 
  group_by(breed_rc) |> 
  count() |> 
  arrange(desc(n)) |> 
  head(5) |> 
  mutate(breed_rc = factor(breed_rc, levels = breed_rc))
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(top_5,
       aes(x = reorder(breed_rc, -n),
           y = n)) +
  
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           aes(fill = breed_rc)) +
  
  labs(title = "Top 5 Dogs in NYC",
       x = "Breed",
       y = "") +
  
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title="Dog Breed")) +
  
  theme_bw() +
  
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  ) +
  
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Pastel1")
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](dog-blog_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-4-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::




# The Top 5 Breeds Popularity by Zip Code



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
map_df <- left_join(nyc_zips_df, nyc_zips_coord)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
dog_breed <- nyc_dog_license |> 
  filter(breed_rc %in% c("Yorkshire Terrier", "Labrador (or Crossbreed)", "Shih Tzu", "Pit Bull (or Mix)", "Chihuahua")) |>
  group_by(borough, breed_rc) |> 
  mutate(n = n())

map <- left_join(map_df, dog_breed)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
alwan <- c("Chihuahua" = "#f6bd60",
           "Labrador (or Crossbreed)" = "#f7ede2",
           "Pit Bull (or Mix)" = "#f5cac3",
           "Shih Tzu" = "#84a59d",
           "Yorkshire Terrier" = "#f28482",
           "NA" = "grey")

ggplot(map,
       aes(x = X,
           y = Y,
           group = zip_code,
           fill = breed_rc)) +
  
  geom_polygon() +
  
  labs(title = "The Top 5 Breeds Popularity by Zip Code") +
  
  theme_void() +
  
  theme(
    legend.direction = "horizontal",
    legend.position = "top",
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 20),
    legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.5, "cm")
  ) +
  
  guides(fill=guide_legend(title=" ",
                           nrow = 1,
                           title.position = "top",
                           label.position = "bottom")) +
  
  coord_map(projection = "albers", lat0 = 39, lat1 = 45) +
  
  scale_fill_manual(values = alwan)
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](dog-blog_files/figure-html/unnamed-chunk-7-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::


It appears the top 5 dog breeds are spread rather equally across NYC, with the Yorkie and Lab taking up a couple large areas compared to the rest. There also appears to be a couple areas where none of the top 5 appear to be licensed in. Particularly in the South East. We'll be exploring which dogs are popular in these zip codes in the following section.  

# Observing Other Dog Breeds Within Zip Codes Without the Top 5



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
og_zip <-unique(nyc_dog_license$zip_code)
og_zip <- data.frame(zip_code = og_zip)


new_zip <- unique(dog_breed$zip_code)
new_zip <- data.frame(zip_code = new_zip)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
missing <- anti_join(og_zip, new_zip)

missing_zip <- missing$zip_code
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
other_zips <- nyc_dog_license |> 
  filter(zip_code %in% missing_zip) |> 
  group_by(breed_rc) |> 
  count()
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
unique(other_zips$breed_rc)
```

ggplot(other_zips,
       aes(x = n,
           y = reorder(breed_rc, n))) +
  
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           aes(fill = breed_rc)) +
    
  labs(title = "Dogs in Zip Codes Where Top 5 are Missing",
